team.abilityDesc: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

moves.name: Scald
moves.desc: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.desc: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
mechanics: Coloca Púas Tóxicas en el equipo rival

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.desc: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Haze
moves.desc: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and defensive stat changes.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.desc: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
mechanics: Retroceso: pierde el 33% del daño causado

moves.name: Toxic
moves.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
mechanics: El usuario cambia de Pokémon tras atacar

moves.name: Roost
moves.desc: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

team.abilityDesc: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.desc: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.desc: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.desc: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.desc: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.
